_comment: Annotated example for poll_connector.py --config. Copy this, point it at your actual SIEM/EDR's alert-listing endpoint, and describe that API's real JSON shape below — none of these values are real. Delete this _comment field (or leave it; it's ignored) before using.
name: my-siem
_comment_auth: auth_token_env names an ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE holding the real token — never put the token itself in this file. Set it in your .env or the process environment.
_comment_records_path: Dotted path to the list of alert records within the JSON response body. Use null (or omit) if the response body IS that list.
_comment_cursor: Incremental polling: after each fetch, the LAST record's cursor_field value is remembered and sent as cursor_query_param on the next request. Omit both to always fetch fresh with no narrowing.
_comment_field_map: Maps SentinelOS's own alert fields to a dotted path within ONE record, in your API's real field names. Only description is required in practice (everything else defaults sensibly if omitted).
